subject.title: [Bug] TOCTOU race condition in cross-device move fallback unlinking

question: Should the narrowed replacement-entry data-loss race remain security-routed or be handled as an ordinary sandbox bug?
rationale: The code defect is concrete, but deciding whether deletion within an already-authorized parent crosses the project’s security boundary requires sandbox security-owner trust-model judgment.

options.title: Keep bounded security review
options.body: Fix the leaf identity gap with security-owner review while documenting that the demonstrated impact is confined to the authorized source parent.

options.title: Reclassify as data-loss bug
options.body: Handle the same narrow repair through the ordinary sandbox bug workflow without a security classification.

options.title: Accept current semantics
options.body: Treat deletion of the current source basename during a concurrent replacement as intentional move behavior and leave the shipped implementation unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep bounded security review
recommendation.body: Fix the leaf identity gap with security-owner review while documenting that the demonstrated impact is confined to the authorized source parent.
